cues: Fix a point S, the focus, and a line, the directrix.
A conic is the path of a point P whose distance from the focus is always a fixed multiple e of its distance from the directrix.
The number e is the eccentricity.
text: Here is the single rule. Fix a point S, the focus, and a line, the directrix. A conic is the path of a point P whose distance from the focus is always a fixed multiple e of its distance from the directrix. The number e is the eccentricity.
